title: New Senior Housing & Land Acquisition
summary:
*   **Public Land for Affordable Housing:** The Housing Finance Corporation accepted 208 acres in the Colony Park neighborhood to develop future low and moderate-income housing.
*   **Public Input on Senior Housing Project:** A public hearing was conducted regarding the issuance of up to $9 million in bonds to finance the Arbors at Creekside Apartments, a proposed 176-unit affordable senior citizen complex.
*   **Major Senior Living Project Approved:** The Arbors at Creekside Apartments, an affordable 176-unit senior living complex, was approved. This included authorizing up to $9 million in financing, official co-development by the Housing Finance Corporation, and securing the land through purchase and a long-term lease.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
THURSDAY, MAY 24,2001
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened at
3:59 p.m. on Thursday, May 24, in the Hancock Building Board Room at the Lower Colorado
River Authority, 3700 Lake Austin Blvd. 
The following agenda were the AHFC items
considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
The following items were acted on by one motion. No separate discussion or action occurred on
any of the items. The consent items were approved on Board Member Wynn's motion, Board
Member Thomas' second by a 6-0 vote. Board Member Griffith was absent.
1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of April
19,2001.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of April
19,2001 were approved.
2. 
Accept from the City of Austin a conveyance of an estimated 208 acres of property located
along Loyola Lane in the Colony Park neighborhood for the purpose for the purpose of
coordinating the development of low and moderate income housing.
Resolution No. 010524-02 was approved.
Item 3 was pulled for discussion.
4. 
Approve the issuance of Austin Housing Finance Corporation Multifamily Housing Revenue
Bonds (Arbors at Creekside Project) Series 2001, in an amount not to exceed an aggregate
principal amount of $9,000,000; the form and substance of a trust indenture, a loan agreement,
a regulatory agreement with respect to the project; and other matters in connection with the
transaction to finance the development and construction of the Arbors at Creekside Apartments
located at 1022 Clayton Lane to be owned and operated by the Arbors Housing Partners, Ltd., a
newly formed Texas limited partnership
Resolution No. 010524-04 was approved.
5. 
Approve a Resolution to authorize the negotiation of an agreement for AHFC to participate as
co-developer of the Arbors at Creekside, an affordable 176-unit senior citizen apartment
complex to be constructed at 1022 Clayton Lane which would be owned and operated by the
Arbors Housing Partners, LTD, a newly formed Texas limited partnership.
Resolution No. 010524-05 was approved.
6. 
Approve a Resolution to authorize the creation of the Arbors at Creekside Non-Profit
Corporation, a new single purpose non-profit corporation, to participate in the development of
the Arbors at Creekside, a 176-unit affordable senior citizen apartment complex to be
constructed at 1022 Clayton Lane, which would be owned and operated by the Arbors at
Creekside, LTD, a newly formed Texas limited partnership.
Resolution No. 010524-06 was approved.
7. 
Approve a Resolution to authorize the negotiation and execution of a contract not to exceed
$1,000,000 for the purchase of approximately 4.5 acres of property at 1022 Clayton Lane for
the development of the Arbors at Creekside Apartments, a 176-unit affordable senior citizen
project, which would be owned and operated by the Arbors Housing Partners, LTD, a newly
formed Texas limited partnership.
Resolution No. 010524-07 was approved.
8. 
Approve a Resolution to authorize the negotiation and execution of a lease of up tp 50 years
approximately 4.5 acres of property located at 1022 Clayton Lane, site of the proposed Arbors
at Creekside Apartments, a 176-unit affordable senior citizen project to Arbors Housing
Partners, Ltd.
Resolution No. 010524-08 was approved.
DISCUSSION ITEMS
3. 
Conduct a public hearing on May 24, 2001 for the purpose of receiving public input on the
issuance of up to $9,000,000 in private activity multi-family non-recourse bonds to finance the
construction of the Arbors at Creekside Apartments, a 176-unit affordable senior citizen project
at 1022 Clayton Lane, which would be owned and operated by the Arbors Housing Partners,
LTD, a newly formed Texas limited partnership.
The public hearing was closed on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board Member
Alvarez4 second by a 6-0 vote. Board Member Griffith was absent.
The motion to adjourn the board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation at 4:03
p.m. was approved on Board Member Thomas' motion, Vice President Goodman's second by a
6-0 vote. Board Member Griffith was absent.
